notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
After a deep investigation, we discovered the command to unlock the CGs in the gallery was partially working. Now, we have fixed it, and you'll be able to see all CGs in your gallery after you find them in the game.

Male Doll Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

Thank you so much for the feedback. We've fixed some bugs and made minor adjustments. Check them out:


Now, you can complete Ayden's Justice Route without a black screen;
The final adult scene between Evan and Ayden is available only in the Justice Route;
When you meet Ayden for the first time in the lab, he will be naked when the text talks about it.
2 achievements have been implemented, so we can check if you guys are completing the whole game. The Steam images for them will be updated on Monday.
The settings option has been removed from the dialog box to avoid bugs. We hope to bring it back soon.
Minor bugs have been fixed.

Thank you so much for the feedback. We're happy you are enjoying the game!

Male Doll Team
